text.arabic_uthmani: وَقَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَكْرُ جَمِيعًۭا ۖ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلْكُفَّٰرُ لِمَنْ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ

words.gloss_range: opening connector that resumes the argument and prepares the verified past premise with qad
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as continuation before verification: the reader hears the argument resume before the historical proof arrives. Its payoff is not simple addition but a connected evidential beat that carries the previous sovereignty claim into the precedent of past scheming.

topics.headline: resumptive verified-history opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah resumes the argument as historical proof rather than beginning a detached report.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a conjunction, and the following qad plus boundary rows support a connected evidential opening.

words.gloss_range: certainty particle before a perfect verb, making the past plotting established rather than hypothetical
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) certifies the following perfect verb as established past action. The plotting is not a possibility or a loose memory; it is put on record as the firm premise for the counter-claim that follows.

topics.headline: certified completed past
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the past plotting is asserted as verified precedent, not floated as a possibility.
topics.reason: QAC marks qad as a certainty particle before a perfect verb, selecting taḥqīq and completion for the local frame.

words.gloss_range: completed objectless scheming, with covert-strategy force later reclassified under divine ownership
words.root_gloss_range: strategy and concealed plotting; locally active as completed human scheming under divine counter-ownership, not every broader branch of the root.
words.prose: {{ar:مَكَرَ}} ({{tr:makara}}) presents completed scheming without naming an object, so the conduct itself becomes the issue. The root {{ar:م ك ر}} ({{tr:m-k-r}}) gives covert strategy and redirection force, and the ayah then turns that human act into the domain God owns. Even the hard middle consonant can be kept as a bounded sound-texture payoff: it fits the embedded hardness of covert maneuver without proving the sense by itself.

topics.headline: objectless completed scheming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah foregrounds scheming as conduct itself rather than a plot against a named target.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the verb frame as objectless absolute, while qad and the perfect form ground it as completed historical action.

topics.headline: covert strategy under divine counter-field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hidden human strategy is immediately drawn into the Quranic pattern of divine counter-design.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence supports covert strategy, and the local co-occurrence with the divine ownership clause licenses the counter-makr payoff without making all root branches active.

topics.headline: root reprise subordinates human action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root returns later as a divine-owned noun, so human action becomes subordinate inside the ayahs own structure.
topics.reason: The same root occurs in word 3 and word 10, with a form shift from perfect verb to definite verbal noun in a fronted ownership clause.

topics.headline: hard-centered sound texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small sound-image where the hard middle consonant fits the idea of embedded covert maneuver.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows are interpretive and not grammatical proof, but they offer a bounded sound-texture payoff that does not control the lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: open plural relative subject that names a class by its action and prior-time frame rather than by ethnicity or tribe
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the past schemers an open relative class. The verse does not need to name a tribe or polity; their identity is supplied by the act of scheming and by their position as predecessors, so they become a recurring warning class rather than a closed historical list.

topics.headline: open relative predecessor class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the past schemers are a recurring class, not a named historical list.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the relative pronoun the subject of makara, while the open relative form and prior-time modifier keep the referent expandable.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the temporal source phrase, turning before-ness into historical precedent
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) governs the before-phrase and makes the past feel like a source-domain behind the current deniers. The preposition turns spatial source pressure into temporal precedent.

topics.headline: temporal-source governor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the predecessors are placed as a source of historical warning behind the present audience.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes min govern qablihim; the local function is temporal source, with spatial and partitive pressures only coloring the historical frame.

words.gloss_range: genitive temporal noun with suffix, making the past predecessors specifically before the warned group
words.root_gloss_range: before-ness with facing or receiving background; locally selected as temporal priority tied to the current audience by suffix.
words.prose: {{ar:قَبْلِهِمْ}} ({{tr:qablihim}}) fixes the predecessors as before them, not as an abstract past. The root {{ar:ق ب ل}} ({{tr:q-b-l}}) supplies a facing background, while the local noun form and suffix keep the active sense narrowed to temporal priority that confronts the present audience. The phrase also closes a same-surah warning thread of prior-generation framing (13:30; 13:32; 13:38).

topics.headline: genitive before-them frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the past is measured relative to the current them, not presented as free-floating antiquity.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark qablihim as genitive under min with a third-plural suffix, selecting temporal anteriority as the local noun-frame.

topics.headline: facing precedent pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the before-time is imagined as a precedent facing the current audience, while the local sense remains temporal before-ness.
topics.reason: The root field includes facing and receiving, but the local adverbial noun under min narrows the selected sense to temporal priority.

topics.headline: historical-warning formula thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase participates in a Quranic and same-surah warning pattern of prior generations (13:30; 13:32; 13:38).
topics.reason: The contextual rows support formulaic historical warning recurrence, and the local phrase sits exactly in the predecessor modifier.

words.gloss_range: resultative and explicative pivot from completed human scheming to divine ownership
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge where the ayah pivots from human initiative to divine preemption. The ownership claim follows as consequence and explanation, so the response to scheming is compressed into the particle itself.

topics.headline: resultative pivot into divine preemption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine ownership claim is the immediate consequence and explanation of human plotting.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment identify fa as the resultative or explicative link introducing the counter-statement after the opening verbal clause.

words.gloss_range: possessive lām fronted before the owned noun, foregrounding God as exclusive owner
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) begins the fronted ownership frame. Before the owned thing is named, the grammar has already pointed possession toward God, making the later plot-domain arrive as already claimed.

topics.headline: fronted possessive lām
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ownership is grammatically fronted before the plot-domain is even named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks lillāhi as the fronted predicate and possessive lām; this supports restrictive ownership rather than loose association.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name governed by lām, anchoring the ownership claim in God rather than an abstract principle
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with worship and awe derivation pressure; locally the proper name governed by the possessive lām.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) names the possessor in the ownership clause. The root {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) may carry worship and awe pressure, but the local form is the proper divine name governed by lām, not a generic deity label.

topics.headline: proper divine possessor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the owner of the entire plot-domain is the named God, not an abstract force or a generic deity.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as the divine proper noun governed by lām, and the fronted phrase places the possessor before the possessed noun.

topics.headline: awe and worship derivation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine name carries worship and awe pressure, while local grammar still uses it as the proper name in the ownership clause.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is valid background, but QAC and attachment constrain the local function to the governed proper noun.

topics.headline: misplaced earning echo
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: This row is about the later earning formula, not the local divine-name word.
topics.reason: The row concerns the later kasb formula rather than the divine name, so it adds no word-level payoff for word 9.

words.gloss_range: definite verbal noun for scheming-as-domain, delayed after the fronted possessor and totalized by the next word
words.root_gloss_range: strategy and plotting; locally converted from human action into a definite owned domain assigned to God.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَكْرُ}} ({{tr:al-makru}}) turns the earlier act of scheming into a definite domain. The root {{ar:م ك ر}} ({{tr:m-k-r}}) repeats, but the grammar changes: human performed action becomes the category placed under divine ownership. The definite form and following totalizer make it scheming-as-such, so the same term can hold human plot and divine counter-design, with the same-surah reversal from adorned makr in 13:33 now made explicit.

topics.headline: delayed owned strategy-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that scheming is introduced as an owned domain after the owner has already been named.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment mark al-makru as a delayed subject after the fronted predicate, and the maṣdar form names the domain rather than staging a second action.

topics.headline: exhaustive counter-makr category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same strategy term holds both human scheming and divine counter-design while the definite form makes the category exhaustive.
topics.reason: The definite maṣdar, ownership predicate, and following jamīʿan support categorical ownership; same-surah 13:33 provides a concrete reversal of apparent possession.

topics.headline: verb-to-noun transfer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammar enacts transfer: what appeared as their act becomes Gods owned category.
topics.reason: The local repetition moves from word 3 as perfect verb to word 10 as definite noun, and the totality formula echoes 13:31.

words.gloss_range: accusative circumstantial totalizer, making all scheming gathered under the ownership claim
words.root_gloss_range: gathering and totality; locally a nominal totalizer that collects the whole plot-domain without remainder.
words.prose: {{ar:جَمِيعًۭا}} ({{tr:jamīʿan}}) makes totality the state of the plot-domain. The root {{ar:ج م ع}} ({{tr:j-m-ʿ}}) gives a gathering payoff: scattered schemes are conceptually collected under one ownership claim, extending the surah-level totality pattern from command in 13:31 to plot here.

topics.headline: accusative total state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that totality is the state in which the whole plot-domain belongs to God.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment mark jamīʿan as accusative ḥāl modifying al-makr, reinforcing the already definite category.

topics.headline: gathered scattered plots
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that many schemes are gathered into one total field under divine control.
topics.reason: The j-m-ʿ root field supports gathering as a positive image, while same-surah totality at 13:18 and 13:31 anchors the recurrence.

words.gloss_range: present imperfect knowledge verb with implied divine subject, opening the knowledge-of-earning clause
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, marking, and known-world field; locally present divine knowledge of earning.
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamu}}) shifts from ownership to present divine knowledge without a connector. The root {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) keeps the known world and marked action in view: God knows now what every self is earning, before the deniers later come to know. This also makes the swift reckoning claim of 13:41 concrete as knowledge of each selfs earning.

topics.headline: present divine knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine knowledge is present and continuous, not a later discovery.
topics.reason: QAC marks an imperfect verb with implied divine subject, and attachment links that subject back to the divine possessor.

topics.headline: marked-world knowledge pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the knowledge-root can evoke marked reality and world, while local syntax keeps the selected sense as knowing each earning.
topics.reason: The root-family pressure is valid background, but the direct-object structure selects cognition aimed at the following earning clause.

topics.headline: asyndetic knowledge turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the abrupt move from ownership to knowledge without another connector.
topics.reason: The clause begins after jamīʿan without a conjunction, making ownership and knowledge closely adjacent in discourse.

topics.headline: present-future knowledge arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah contrasts what God knows now with what deniers will know later.
topics.reason: The same root appears at word 12 and word 18 with changed tense and subject, building the temporal epistemic arc.

topics.headline: reckoning specified as earning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior reckoning claim is specified as knowledge of each selfs earning (13:41).
topics.reason: The boundary row links 13:41 reckoning with the local knowledge-of-kasb clause, and attachment confirms mā taksibu as the object content.

words.gloss_range: object hinge that can point to what is earned or to the earning process itself
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is the hinge that makes earning the content of divine knowledge. Its form leaves room for both the things earned and the earning-process itself, so the scope stays open instead of becoming an inventory.

topics.headline: open object hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine knowledge covers both earned contents and the earning process without listing either.
topics.reason: QAC marks mā as a relative object, while CRITICAL rows preserve the locally licensed maṣdariyya reparse as a scope nuance.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect earning verb, broad and ongoing, with an open object and individual feminine agreement
words.root_gloss_range: earning and acquisition; locally broad Form I acquisition, not narrowed to reflexive culpable acquisition.
words.prose: {{ar:تَكْسِبُ}} ({{tr:taksibu}}) keeps earning broad, ongoing, and individually tracked. The root {{ar:ك س ب}} ({{tr:k-s-b}}) appears here in Form I, so the phrase covers acquisition generally rather than only a narrower reflexive culpability sense. Because it is paired with every self, the wording reprises the same-surah accountability formula from 13:33 with present, ongoing force.

topics.headline: individual open acquisition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that each self is tracked through an ongoing open field of earning.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment show a 3fs imperfect verb with subject kullu and object mā, supporting ongoing individual acquisition.

topics.headline: broad Form I earning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording keeps earning broad and neutral, while contrast with Form VIII only limits what is not selected here.
topics.reason: V4 and CRITICAL rows contrast Form I with Form VIII, but the local form is plainly Form I and should not be over-narrowed to culpable reflexive acquisition.

topics.headline: self-earning accountability pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that selfhood and earning form a Quranic accountability pair, repeated from 13:33 with an ongoing present force here.
topics.reason: The local phrase taksibu kullu nafsin matches the known kasb-nafs pairing, and same-surah 13:33 supplies the concrete echo.

words.gloss_range: distributive universal quantifier functioning as the subject of earning in construct with nafs
words.root_gloss_range: totality with completion-to-exhaustion background; locally distributive every-ness over each self.
words.prose: {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}) makes universality distributive. The root {{ar:ك ل ل}} ({{tr:k-l-l}}) adds completion pressure, while the construct with the following self means each individual falls under the knowledge claim rather than disappearing into a collective. Its same-surah recurrence keeps the final knowledge clause inside the accountability thread of 13:16 and 13:33.

topics.headline: distributive universal subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that everyness is syntactically active: each individual self is separately covered.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment make kullu the nominative subject in iḍāfa with an indefinite nafs, yielding distributive universality.

topics.headline: completion-to-exhaustion pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that totality feels complete down to the last self, while the local word still functions as the ordinary universal quantifier.
topics.reason: The root background includes exhaustion and completion, but local grammar selects kull as a quantifier rather than an exhaustion predicate.

topics.headline: same-surah accountability formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final knowledge clause reprises the surahs universal self-accountability thread (13:16; 13:33).
topics.reason: The same-surah recurrence supports a formulaic payoff without altering the local construct grammar.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular self in genitive construct, maximizing individual accountability coverage
words.root_gloss_range: self, breath, desire, and preciousness; locally the individuated self whose earning is known.
words.prose: {{ar:نَفْسٍۢ}} ({{tr:nafsin}}) supplies the individual self governed by every, with the indefinite singular keeping the coverage open to every entity counted as a self. The root {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}) lets selfhood carry breath and desire background, but locally the word is the genitive construct complement whose earning is known. The self stands between earning and knowledge in the surahs accountability thread (13:11; 13:16; 13:33), and the nasal close gives the phrase a compact cadence.

topics.headline: open individual self
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accountability is maximally open to every entity counted as a self, not restricted by social class.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment mark nafsin as an indefinite singular genitive complement of kull, supporting open individual coverage.

topics.headline: breath and desire background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accountable self is living and desiring, while local grammar keeps the word as the noun self.
topics.reason: The n-f-s root field gives breath and desire pressure, but the local nominal form is not a verb of breathing or desiring.

topics.headline: self known by earning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the self stands between earning and divine knowledge, closing the surahs self-accountability thread (13:11; 13:16; 13:33).
topics.reason: Contextual evidence links n-f-s with k-s-b and ʿ-l-m, and the local syntax places nafs inside the earning clause known by God.

topics.headline: compact nasal cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a compact sound closure binding the universal quantifier to the individual self.
topics.reason: The sound row is limited to cadence and does not determine syntax or sense, but it gives a real local auditory payoff.

words.gloss_range: connector opening the final warning clause and pivoting from divine present knowledge to deniers future knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the final warning movement. It coordinates with the divine knowledge clause while also restarting the discourse toward the deniers future realization.

topics.headline: final warning connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivots from what God knows now to what deniers will be forced to know later.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the conjunction introducing the eschatological warning clause, and the following sa-prefix makes the movement future-oriented.

words.gloss_range: future-marked knowledge verb, making the deniers recognition certain and delayed after God already knows
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge and recognition; locally future forced realization by deniers in contrast to present divine knowledge.
words.prose: {{ar:سَيَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:sa-yaʿlamu}}) makes knowledge future, certain, and threatening for the deniers. The verb comes before the plural subject, so the event of knowing is foregrounded before the deniers are named. The root {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) repeats the present divine knowing from earlier, but now the agents arrive late; variant evidence adds a disclosure angle while the canonical active form keeps them as the knowers.

topics.headline: certain future recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deniers future knowledge is not neutral learning but unavoidable recognition.
topics.reason: QAC marks a future-prefixed imperfect with al-kuffār as following subject; discourse rows construe it as a warning formula.

topics.headline: passive disclosure variant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a variant apparatus pressure where the outcome is made known, while the canonical local parse keeps deniers as active grammatical subjects.
topics.reason: The passive rows are useful contrast, but attachment and QAC for the canonical surface identify al-kuffār as the subject of active sa-yaʿlamu.

topics.headline: knowledge-root temporal arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same knowing-root is split across unequal times and agents: God now, deniers later.
topics.reason: The local repetition of ʿ-l-m at words 12 and 18 supports the present-future contrast, with sa marking the later realization.

words.gloss_range: definite intensive plural subject, identifying the warning class as persistent coverers and deniers
words.root_gloss_range: covering, denial, and ingratitude; locally an intensive definite class of persistent deniers.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكُفَّٰرُ}} ({{tr:al-kuffāru}}) names the subject who will know. The root {{ar:ك ف ر}} ({{tr:k-f-r}}) makes denial an active covering, and the intensive plural form marks a recognized class of persistent deniers rather than occasional doubters. Variant evidence can personify disbelief or genericize the denier, but the canonical surface keeps the warning aimed at this intensive plural class.

topics.headline: intensive denier class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the subject is a recognized class of persistent truth-coverers who will themselves undergo the future realization.
topics.reason: QAC marks al-kuffāru as the definite intensive plural subject, and the k-f-r root field supports moral-epistemic covering.

topics.headline: subject variant apparatus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant evidence can personify disbelief or genericize the denier, while the canonical wording targets the intensive plural class.
topics.reason: The variant rows offer contrast, but QAC and attachment constrain the local standard parse to nominative al-kuffāru as subject.

words.gloss_range: second lām forming the for-whom frame of the final outcome question
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) forms the final for-whom frame. It turns the closing clause into a question of possession, specification, and allocation; the first lām declared ownership of scheming, while this second lām withholds the owner of the outcome.

topics.headline: for-whom ownership question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final issue is whose outcome it is, and the answer is withheld inside the warning.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes li-man the fronted predicate of the embedded question, while the two lām frames link ownership of makr to allocation of the outcome.

words.gloss_range: uninflected identity pronoun governed by lām, leaving the beneficiary or possessor deliberately unnamed
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) keeps the final answer suspended. Whether read as interrogative or relative, the uninflected pronoun creates an identity slot: the deniers will know for whom the outcome is, but the ayah does not name that party here.

topics.headline: suspended identity slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that closure withholds the beneficiary or possessor instead of naming believers or the righteous here.
topics.reason: QAC allows relative or interrogative man, and attachment marks it as governed by lām in the embedded content clause.

words.gloss_range: delayed subject and construct head for the final outcome, recalling the surahs positive outcome formula
words.root_gloss_range: following-after, consequence, and outcome; locally the final positive outcome bound to the abode formula.
words.prose: {{ar:عُقْبَى}} ({{tr:ʿuqbā}}) is delayed in syntax just as the outcome is delayed in realization. The root {{ar:ع ق ب}} ({{tr:ʿ-q-b}}) makes the end what follows from action, and the same-surah formula already tied to reward at 13:22 and 13:24 sharpens what the deniers will learn. The boundary echo from 13:41 also matters: the would-be reverser is blocked there, while here the following consequence is delivered.

topics.headline: delayed construct outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the outcome exists syntactically but is delayed after the for-whom frame.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment identify ʿuqbā as the delayed subject and construct head governing al-dār, matching the semantic delay of final outcome.

topics.headline: positive consequence sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question concerns who receives the praiseworthy final outcome, while the root still evokes consequence as what follows action.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence distinguishes ʿuqbā from punitive ʿuqūba, but the local construct formula keeps the focus on the final outcome of the abode.

topics.headline: same-surah outcome formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final question recalls the reward formula already used for the righteous at 13:22 and 13:24.
topics.reason: The same-surah references explicitly anchor ʿuqbā al-dār at 13:22 and 13:24 before its return in 13:42.

topics.headline: boundary reversal to delivered outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the blocked reverser of 13:41 turns into the delivered consequence of 13:42.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence connects 13:41s no-reversal language with 13:42s outcome and earning content, giving a concrete local transition.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive abode completing the outcome formula and giving the ayah its final destination
words.root_gloss_range: dwelling, domain, and return-cycle; locally the definite abode that completes the final outcome formula.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدَّارِ}} ({{tr:al-dār}}) completes the final formula as the genitive abode. The root {{ar:د و ر}} ({{tr:d-w-r}}) gives return-domain pressure, but the local noun makes the cycle a definite destination, so the ayah lands not on the deniers but on the abode whose outcome is at stake. The formula recurs at 13:22, 13:24, and 13:42, and the broad final sound gives that abode-thread a stable acoustic landing.

topics.headline: genitive definite abode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes on a known decisive abode bound to the outcome, not on a generic place.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment mark al-dār as the genitive complement of ʿuqbā, and definiteness presupposes the recognizable final domain.

topics.headline: return-domain root image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that abode carries return-cycle and domain pressure, while the local noun form makes that motion into a settled destination.
topics.reason: The d-w-r root has revolving and returning imagery, but QAC identifies the local form as a concrete noun in construct, not an active motion verb.

topics.headline: surah-level abode landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah and surah land on the abode-thread, with the formula recurring at 13:22, 13:24, and 13:42.
topics.reason: Contextual rows support the recurring ʿuqbā al-dār formula and same-surah dār thread, and the final position makes the abode the destination of the sequence.

topics.headline: final sound closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word gives the ayah a broad and stable acoustic landing.
topics.reason: The sound row supplies a bounded cadence payoff and does not alter the grammatical genitive relation.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.scope_en: Covers worship, devotion, and a being or thing treated as an object of worship, including deity, idols, and the sun when named for being worshipped.

variants.scope_en: Covers worship, devotion, and a being or thing treated as an object of worship, including deity, idols, and the sun when named for being worshipped.

branches.image_en: Allah as a fixed name in oath and invocation formulas

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The totalizing ownership clause at words 6-8 is set against the distributive account of every self at words 9-13 and the final outcome at word 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: Strategic agency is gathered without remainder at the divine level, while gain is accrued self by self. Complete present knowledge connects those unequal scales, and the terminal outcome publicly tests which level actually governed the process.

activation_trace.role: Completion without loss makes the ownership claim exhaustive rather than merely extensive.
Enclosing totality distributes the knowledge claim over every member of the set.
The self as an integral identity makes each agent, not an abstract mass, the unit of accrual.
Acquisition for oneself turns action into an increment retained by its agent.
Knowledge as disclosure links hidden acquisition now to recognition later.
The last state of an act supplies the public endpoint at which ownership is resolved.

changed_reading.before: The verse says that God defeats earlier plotters and knows their deeds.
changed_reading.after: The verse contrasts totalized strategic sovereignty with strictly individualized accrual: every scheme is encompassed, every self retains its gain, and the ending reveals the asymmetry.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Past plotting, present divine knowledge, and future human knowledge form a three-stage temporal construction around words 2, 9, 14, and 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: Predecessors act first and cover their position, but divine knowledge is already present; the disbelievers acquire knowledge only when the consequence arrives. The threat is therefore an epistemic reversal as much as a strategic defeat.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence places the earlier plotters at the front of a recurring sequence, not outside the present case.
Already disclosed knowledge on one side contrasts with delayed recognition on the other.
A distinguishing mark supplies the moment when a formerly hidden alignment becomes legible.
Covering supplies the concealment pole that the later marked disclosure reverses.
The final consequence is the event that forces the delayed knower to recognize the governing order.

changed_reading.before: The future verb merely announces that the disbelievers will eventually learn their fate.
changed_reading.after: Their future knowing is the designed reversal of covered plotting: God knows during acquisition, while they know only when the ending itself becomes the mark.

context_deltas.mechanism: Outcome-aware governance at 13:2 and the near-identical ownership clause at 13:31 activate the resolve branch of total gathering. The focus claim now places plotting inside one consolidated command structure rather than presenting two rival secret plans.

activation_trace.role: Managing an affair by looking to its consequence supplies the long-horizon governing operation.
Deliberation and ordered counsel make command a planned process rather than a bare event.
Authority over the affair supplies the ownership frame later transferred to all plotting.
Gathered and settled resolve turns the totalizer into a possible image of consolidated decision.
The same resolve branch anchors consolidation directly in the focus ownership clause.

structural_cues: The clauses at 13:31 and 13:42 share a dative ownership frame and terminal totalizer, while 13:2 places consequence-aware governing before both.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies planning, authority, consolidated resolve, and a close clause parallel; I infer that strategy is nested in command. A live alternative is that the parallel marks emphatic ownership only and leaves the resolve branch inactive.

changed_reading.before: All plots ultimately belong to God in the sense that He can counter each one.
changed_reading.after: All plotting is already contained within a single, consequence-aware governance whose deliberative resolve gathers every apparent counter-plan.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered sequence of extension, seizure, fixed term, and binding record makes time itself the countermeasure. Delay permits each self's gain to accumulate visibly before the terminal taking, explaining why present knowledge and future recognition are separated.

activation_trace.role: Extending time while granting respite supplies the strategic interval rather than an absence of response.
Taking in consequence of fault closes the interval with accountable capture.
A prescribed temporal limit gives the interval a boundary rather than open-ended postponement.
A binding inscription supplies the rule that fixes each term and makes the sequence enforceable.
Ongoing self-acquisition explains what grows during the granted interval.

structural_cues: At 13:32 respite precedes taking; 13:38 pairs every term with a record; the focus pairs present acquisition with future recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies respite, taking, bounded term, record, and ongoing gain; I infer the arrow respite enables accrual before exposure. The live alternative is that respite expresses forbearance or mercy without functioning as strategy.

changed_reading.before: Divine plotting is an immediate superior countermove against human plotting.
changed_reading.after: Its decisive form may be calibrated delay: agents keep acquiring under a fixed term, then the deferred taking converts hidden gain into known outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence at 13:33 moves from outward speech to beautification, plotting, and diversion. That cluster activates the focus root's pigment branch: human plotting behaves like a treated surface that both attracts and covers, while divine knowledge reaches the self's actual acquisition beneath it.

activation_trace.role: Surface emergence supplies the outward layer on which the following adornment can operate.
Making something appear beautiful supplies the cosmetic operation applied to the plot.
The literal pigment and coloring branch lets the plotted scheme be modeled as a coated surface.
Diversion supplies the functional effect of accepting the beautified surface.
The same coloring branch anchors the surface model in both focus occurrences of plotting.
Covering makes the named agents participants in the same concealment mechanism.

structural_cues: At 13:33 outward wording, passive adornment, their plot, and diversion occur consecutively; 13:42 removes total ownership of plotting from them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surface, beautification, pigment, covering, and diversion; I infer cross-lighting in which a scheme camouflages itself through appearance. The live alternative is that the pigment branch is only a homonymic echo and ordinary strategic plotting remains unaffected.

changed_reading.before: Their plot is a hidden plan made attractive to them.
changed_reading.after: Their plot is also readable as an attractive coating that produces misdirection; total divine ownership means no manufactured surface can hide the underlying acquisition or its end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-verbatim pairing of every self with what it acquired at 13:33 turns bare omniscience into standing supervision. The later allocation of accounting, judgment, and absence of review makes the focus outcome the closed result of a per-agent ledger.

activation_trace.role: Standing as care, preservation, and authority supplies continuous supervision over each agent.
Self-acquired gain is the exact ledger item shared with the focus clause.
Counting and reckoning supply the explicit accounting operation assigned to the divine side.
Adjudication between parties converts the ledger into a ruling.
Following a ruling to challenge or reverse it supplies the expressly blocked review stage.
The terminal consequence becomes the closed result left after supervision, account, and ruling.

structural_cues: 13:33 and 13:42 pair every self with acquired gain; 13:40-41 then sequence account, judgment, and denial of a reviewer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supervision, identical gain language, accounting, judgment, and blocked review; I infer one administrative chain. The live alternative is that the standing clause is rhetorical guardianship and the legal-ledger continuity is only analogical.

changed_reading.before: God simply knows each deed and later announces the winner.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge is active oversight of an individualized ledger, and the outcome of the abode is a final, non-reviewable adjudication rather than a bare prediction.

context_deltas.mechanism: A hostile circuit reaches the dwelling at 13:31 while the land contracts from its edges at 13:41. These spatial cues activate circulation in the focus abode: its outcome is the last turn of a domain whose perimeter is progressively closed.

activation_trace.role: A harmful turn enclosing a group supplies the circuit already approaching their dwelling.
Loss of part of a whole supplies progressive territorial contraction.
The outer limit supplies the perimeter from which contraction advances inward.
Circulation and turnover of conditions let the abode function as a changing domain, not only a destination.
The final state fixes which party possesses the domain after its last turn.

structural_cues: At 13:31 calamity either strikes or settles near their dwelling; 13:41 immediately before the focus depicts land diminished from its outer limits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an adverse circuit near the dwelling, shrinking edges, turnover, and final state; I infer an inward-closing spatial process. The live alternative is that the dwelling references and territorial image remain separate eschatological and historical motifs.

changed_reading.before: The outcome of the abode names only a remote final destination.
changed_reading.after: It can also name the final turn of a lived domain: plotting continues while the surrounding field contracts, until the adverse circuit reaches home and ownership is disclosed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a material irrigation branch into strategic language. It remains valid as an activation because that branch is attached to both focus occurrences and the context supplies irrigation, cultivation, and delayed persistence; downstream prose should label it a cross-domain exploratory model, never a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both focus occurrences of the plotting root at words 2 and 7, followed by each self's acquisition at word 11, support a preparatory-field analogy.

activation_trace.role: Pre-plow watering of firm ground supplies hidden preparation before a later visible result.
Causing irrigation supplies the explicit contextual action that activates preparatory watering.
Cultivated growth supplies the field in which one preparation can yield differentiated results.
Stable waiting supplies latency between preparation and the durable residue that remains.
Each agent's acquired increment functions as the eventual yield of the prepared field.

changed_reading.before: Divine plotting is solely a secret countermaneuver against hostile plans.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can be imagined as prior conditioning of a resistant field: the ground is prepared invisibly, each self produces its own gain, and the durable yield appears only at the end.

strongest_changes: The close ownership-clause parallel at 13:31 changes plotting from rival secrecy into strategy consolidated under command.
The respite-to-seizure sequence makes calibrated time, not immediate retaliation, the operative countermove.
The exact every-self/acquisition echo at 13:33 and the account-to-no-review sequence turn knowledge into supervised adjudication.
The surface-adornment cluster activates a contained pigment reading in which human plotting camouflages itself.
summary.what_was_special: The focus combines collective totalization with individual accrual, then the context supplies two unusually exact activators: the command/plot ownership parallel and the outward-speech, adornment, pigment, covering, and diversion sequence. A separate irrigation inventory opens a coherent but explicitly exploratory cultivation model.
remaining_uncertainties: The gathered-resolve branch may be genuine semantic activation or only resonance beneath an ordinary totalizer.
The pigment and irrigation branches may be productive cross-domain echoes without altering the lexical sense of plotting.
The rotational abode model depends on linking territorial contraction to eschatological outcome rather than leaving them as distinct images.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. `ك س ب/B001` is self-acquisition. Plotting is reframed by knowledge of what each self earns. I infer that a plot first enters the plotter's own account before reaching its target; strategy becomes self-implicating.
2. `ع ق ب/B005` is succession, and future `سَيَعْلَمُ` delays recognition until aftermath appears. I infer that consequence discloses whose ordering held. The phrase is both destination and retrospective causal test.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 13:43's sufficient testimony supplied the final evidentiary closure to the knowledge anticipated here.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Distributed schemes are gathered without loss under complete knowledge.** `ج م ع / B001` is gathering scattered parts into one whole and `ج م ع / B009` is wholeness without scattering or loss; `ع ل م / B001` is knowing as a thing becomes clear; `ك س ب / B001` is seeking and obtaining benefit; and `ن ف س / B013` is inner mind or hidden intent. The repeated `مكر` is followed not by a mirrored tactical detail but by all-gathering, knowledge of each self's acquisitions, and eventual knowledge of the dwelling's outcome. Nearby 13:37 warns about post-knowledge desire, 13:39 supplies a source record, and 13:41 supplies continuously supervised quick account. I assign gathering the role of integrating distributed plans and knowledge the role of preserving each contribution's trace. The packet supplies many schemers but comprehensive acquisition-knowledge; I infer aggregation without loss -> no local plan remains outside account. The divine `المكر` therefore reads through total integration and outcome control, not merely superior trickery.

2. **Knowledge reverses from present oversight to future recognition.** The two forms of `ع ل م / B001` move from “He knows” to “the rejectors will know,” while `ع ق ب / B006` names the end and outcome. I assign present knowledge the role of causal oversight and future knowledge the role of compelled recognition at the end. The packet supplies the tense shift; I infer completed outcome -> previously resisted clarity. The closing question is thus about who owns the durable outcome, not who temporarily appears tactically successful.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 13:43's book-grounded witness transformed total gathering into evidentiary sufficiency: schemes and acquisitions are not merely overpowered but integrated into testimony capable of settling the final dispute.

baseline.text: Onlardan öncekiler de tuzak kurmuştu; fakat bütün tuzak Allah'a aittir. O, her kişinin ne kazandığını bilir. İnkâr edenler yurdun sonunun kime ait olduğunu yakında bilecekler.

findings.text: Bir tuzak hedefine ulaşmadan önce onu kuranın kendi hesabına girer; strateji bu yüzden sahibini de bağlayan bir kazanımdır.
Dağınık planların tümü, her kişinin gizli niyetini ve kazancını kaybetmeden tek bir kapsamlı bilgi altında toplanır.
Sonuç ortaya çıktığında gelecekteki bilme, daha önce reddedilen düzenin kime ait olduğunu zorunlu bir tanımaya dönüştürür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, gizlice hile kurma ve aldatma yoluyla birini yöneldiği amaçtan çevirme çekirdeğini açıkça verir. Savaşta kurulan düzen bu çekirdeğin özel bir uygulaması, ilahi özneyle kullanılan karşılık verme anlamı ise eylemin adına dayanan bağımlı bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği gizli ve amaç saptırıcı hiledir; savaş düzeni ile hileye verilen ceza bağımsız çekirdekler değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın hile çekirdeğini verir; savaş düzeni ve ilahi karşılık anlamları yalnızca tanıklanan özel kullanımlarla sınırlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseyi gizlice kurulan bir hile veya aldatmayla yöneldiği amaçtan saptırmaktır. Savaşta taktik düzen kurma ve hileye karşılık ceza verme anlamları bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Gizlice hile kurarak veya aldatarak başkasını amaçladığı yönden çevirmek.
Savaş bağlamında karşı tarafı yanıltmaya yönelik taktik bir düzen kurmak.
İlahi özneyle kullanıldığında, yapılan hileye onun adıyla karşılık veya ceza vermeyi anlatmak.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın beden bölümü ve güzellik sınırı nedeniyle karşılıklar olağan kullanımda birbirinin yerine geçmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın temel odağı baldırın dolgun ve güzel kalınlığıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bütün insan bedeninin ip gibi sıkı, uzun veya kıvrak kuruluşunu merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: dolgun baldır ve sıkı kurulmuş beden
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kadının sıkı ve toplu beden yapısını anlatan uzantıda iki dal yaklaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bütün bedene ilişkin yakınlık yalnızca uzantı düzeyindedir; bu dalın baldır odağı komşunun genel beden kuruluşunda yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal baldırın dış görünüşündeki dolgunluğu ve güzelliği niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal baldırın iç veya yan tarafındaki belirgin et ya da kas bölümünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da aynı beden bölgesi olan baldırla ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri baldırın görünüş niteliği, öteki ise baldırdaki belirli anatomik et veya kas parçasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; seçilen üç komşu dolgunluk, genel beden kuruluşu ve baldır anatomisi üzerinden gerçek sınır ayrımları sunar, kalanlar daha uzak beden nitelemeleridir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه خدالة الساق وغلظها الحسن وامتلاؤها، وامرأة ممكورة الساقين، والمطوية الخلق من النساء.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الاحتيال والخداع ولا النبات والشجر ولا المغرة ولا سقي الأرض؛ ولا يلحق به لفظ مكورى في الشتيمة إلا بمراجعة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: المكر: خدالة الساق؛ امرأة ممكورة الساقين (maqayis)؛ المكر حسن خدالة الساق؛ مرتوية الساق خدلة (ayn;tahdhib)؛ الممكورة: المطوية الخلق من النساء؛ خدلاء (sihah)؛ المكرة: الساق الغليظة الحسناء (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir bitkiyi, onun tek örneğini, ağaç türü veya türlerini ve meyvesini adlandırır. Bitkinin iyi su almış oluşu adın gerekçesi olarak aktarılır; dalın her kullanımında bulunması gereken bağımsız bir sulanma koşulu gibi genellenmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bir sulama eylemini değil, belirli bir bitki veya ağaç adını ve buna bağlı tekil ile meyve kullanımlarını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bitki ve ağaç adı yalın çekirdektir; tek örnek ile meyve anlamları yalnızca tanıklanan biçim ve tamlama sınırlarında tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir bitkiyi veya bir ağaç türünü ya da türlerini adlandırır. Tek bir bitki örneği ve bu bitkinin meyvesi için kullanılan bağlı adlandırmalar da dala dahildir.

facets.statement: Belirli bir bitki türünün adı olarak kullanılmak.
Tek bir bitki örneğini ve bir ağaç türünü ya da ağaç türlerini adlandıran biçimlere sahip olmak.
Bitki adının, bitkinin iyi su almış oluşuyla açıklanması.
Belirli bir tamlama içinde bu bitkinin meyvesini anlatmak.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar belirli bir bitki ile ağaç türü veya türlerinin adlandırılmasında birleşir; tekil örnek, adın iyi su alma ile açıklanması ve bitkinin meyvesi de aynı toplu tanıklığın parçalarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: belirli bir bitki veya ağaç türü
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın bitki ile ağaç arasında değişebilen adlandırma çekirdeğini doğal ve kapsayıcı biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir bitkisel türü adlandırmayı ve kaynaklardaki bitki ile ağaç kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Toplu bitki adının tek bir bireyini gösteren biçim açıklanırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitki adını ve topluluktan tek bireye geçişi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca tanıklanan meyve tamlamasının doğal Türkçe karşılığı olarak kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Meyvenin söz konusu bitkiye ait oluşunu ve tamlamaya bağlı kapsamı korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir ağaç türü veya ağaç türleri

error_profile.preserves: Adlandırmayla ilişkilendirilen iyi su alma açıklamasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Belirli bir bitki veya ağaç türünün özel söz varlığı adı olma niteliğini siler.
error_profile.adds: Herhangi bir bitkinin sonradan sulanmış olması gibi genel bir durum anlamı ekler.
error_profile.collision: Adın açıklamasını sulama eyleminin sonucuyla karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal belirli bir bitkiyi, bazı aktarımlarda da ağaç türü veya türlerini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ağaç sayılmayan taze ve yeşil otsu bitkilerin genel sınıfını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: özel bitki adı ve genel yeşil ot sınıfı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bitkisel varlıkların adlandırılması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın belirli tür adı oluşu, komşunun genel bitki sınıfıyla yer değiştirmesini engeller.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bitki ve ağaç arasında değişen, tekil örnek ile meyve kullanımları da bulunan ayrı bir adı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal başka bir belirli ağaç türünün yalın adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: iki ayrı ağaç veya bitki adı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal belirli bir ağaç türünün adı olarak tanıklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak üst alan takson adlandırmasıdır; fakat adlandırılan türler ayrı olduğundan anlamsal ikame yoktur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; komşuların çoğu yalnızca başka bitki adlarıdır. Seçilen iki örnek, genel bitki sınıfı ile ayrı tür adı sınırlarını en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.branch_image_ar: نبات أو شجر مرتو يسمى المكر أو المكور
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النبات المسمى المكر أو المكرة وجمعه مكور، والمكور من الشجر، وثمر المكر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الاحتيال والخداع ولا خدالة الساق ولا المغرة ولا سقي الأرض نفسه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: المكر ضرب من النبات الواحدة مكرة وسميت لارتوائها (ayn;tahdhib)؛ المكور ضرب من الشجر وضروب من الشجر (ayn;sihah;tahdhib)؛ الواحد مكر وفراخ المكر ثمره (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aşı boyasını doğrudan adlandırır ve onunla boyama, boyanma ile sakalların boyanması eylemlerini aynı dalda tanıklar. Madde ile onun kullanıldığı boyama süreci ayrı facetler olarak korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek aşı boyasıdır; boya bitkileri, kırmızı nesneler ve başka boyarmaddeler bu dala kendiliğinden girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad boya maddesini gösterir; boyama, boyanma ve sakala uygulanma yalnızca tanıklanan türemiş kullanımlarda tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Boyama veya sürme amacıyla kullanılan aşı boyasıdır. Aynı boya ile bir şeyi boyama, boyanma ve özellikle sakalların boyanması eylemlerini anlatan kullanımlar da vardır.

facets.statement: Boyama veya yüzeye sürme amacıyla kullanılan aşı boyasını adlandırmak.
Bir şeyi aşı boyasıyla boyamak ve o şeyin bu boyayla boyanmasını anlatmak.
Sakalların aşı boyasıyla boyanmasını özel olarak anlatmak.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar aşı boyasını ve bu maddeyle boyama ya da boyanma eylemini birlikte tanıklar; sakalların boyanması bu kullanımın belirgin özel uygulamasıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın boya maddesini merkez alan yalın anlamı için doğal ve kapsamı belirli karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Boya maddesini, boyama işlevini ve aşı boyası türünü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Boya maddesinden onun uygulanması ve sonucu olan boyanma sürecine geçilen kullanımlarda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Aynı boya maddesini, boyayan eylemi ve boyanma sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Boyama eyleminin özellikle sakallara uygulandığı tanıklanmış kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Boyanın türünü, boyama eylemini ve sakal nesnesini birlikte korur.
Saç veya sakal boyamada kullanılabilen geleneksel boya çağrışımını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kaynakta adlandırılan aşı boyası maddesinin kimliğini siler.
error_profile.adds: Farklı ve bitkisel bir boyarmadde kimliği ekler.
error_profile.collision: İki ayrı boya maddesini kullanım benzerliği nedeniyle birbirine karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal aşı boyasını ve onunla boyama eylemini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal başka maddelerle karıştırılan bitkisel bir boya kaynağını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: aşı boyası ve bitkisel boya kaynağı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bedeni veya başka yüzeyleri renklendirmede kullanılan maddeler alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Boyama işlevi ortak olsa da maddelerin kimliği ve komşudaki bitki olma niteliği farklıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal belirli bir aşı boyasını ve onunla gerçekleştirilen boyama sürecini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal safran benzeri kırmızı veya sarı boyayı ve boyaya iyice doyurulmuş nesneyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal boya maddesi ve yüzeyin renklendirilmesi alanında yakınlaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Renk ve boyama alanındaki yakınlığa rağmen boya maddesinin türü ile tanıklanan sonuç durumları farklıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen iki komşu boya maddesinin kimliği ve uygulanışı bakımından en yakın sınırları verir, öteki adaylar renkli nesne veya kumaş alanında kalır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المكر بمعنى المغرة، والخضب أو الطلاء بها، وامتكار اللحية بمعنى اختضابها.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الاحتيال والخداع ولا النبات والشجر ولا خدالة الساق ولا سقي الأرض.
branches.source_phrase_ar: المكر: المغرة (ayn;sihah)؛ مكره فامتكر أي خضبه فاختضب (sihah)؛ تمتكر اللحى أي تختضب؛ طلي بالمغرة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi toprağı sulama çekirdeğini, sert toprağı sürmeden önce sulama işlemini, ürüne verilen bir sulama payını ve sulanmış ürün durumunu açıkça ayırır. Süreç, tek sulama olayı ve sonuç durumu tanımda birbirine indirgenmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal su verme eylemiyle sınırlıdır; toprağı düzleme, yağmurla yetinme veya ürünün büyümesi kendi başına bu anlam değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın çekirdek toprağı sulamadır; sürme öncesi işlem, tek sulama payı ve sulanmış ürün yalnızca tanıklanan biçimlerde korunur.

concept_map.definition: Toprağa veya ürüne su vermektir. Sert toprağı sürmeden önce sulama, ürüne bir kez su verme ve ürünü sulanmış durumda niteleme bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşimleridir.

facets.statement: Toprağa veya yetiştirilen ürüne su vermek.
Sert toprağı yumuşatmak üzere sürmeden önce sulamak ve ardından sürmek.
Ürüne verilen tek bir sulama payını veya sulama olayını adlandırmak.
Bir ürünü su verilmiş, yani sulanmış durumda nitelemek.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dalın çoğul kaynaklar arasında paylaşılmış bir tanıklığı yoktur; anlam, tek kaynağın sulama süreci, bir sulama payı ve sulanmış ürün durumunu birlikte veren aktarımına dayanır.

source_details.summary: Toprağı sulama, sert toprağı sürme öncesinde suyla hazırlama, ürüne verilen bir sulama ve sulanmış ürün durumu birlikte tanıklanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın su verme işlemini toprak ve yetiştirilen ürün kapsamıyla birlikte veren temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Su verme eylemini ve bu eylemin toprak ya da ürün üzerindeki kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sert arazinin suyla hazırlanıp ardından sürülmesi istenen özel tarım işleminde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Toprağın sertliğini, sulamanın sürmeden önce oluşunu ve sonraki sürme aşamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sürecin tamamı değil, ürüne verilen tek bir sulama payı veya olayı adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ürünü, su verme eylemini ve tek olaylık ölçüyü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Su verme eylemi yerine ürünün bu eylem sonucundaki durumu nitelendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ürün katılımcısını ve su verilmiş olma sonucunu korur.
Tarla, ürün ve su gereksinimi alanını korur.
error_profile.loses: Toprağa veya ürüne bilinçli olarak su verme işlemini siler.
error_profile.adds: Ürünün ayrıca sulanmadan yağmur suyuyla yetinmesi koşulunu ekler.
error_profile.collision: Sulanan araziyle sulamasız yağış tarımını karşıt olmalarına rağmen karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sert toprağı sürmeden önce sulama, tek sulama payı ve sulanmış ürün kullanımlarını ayrıca kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal suyun dolap, kova, bulut veya gök gibi farklı araç ve kaynaklarla sağlanmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak çekirdeği toprağa veya ürüne su vermektir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak çekirdek yakın ikame sağlar; ancak bu dalın sürme öncesi sert toprak ve sonuç durumu kapsamı, komşunun araç ve kaynak kapsamıyla tam örtüşmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal toprağa veya ürüne ayrıca su verilmesini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ayrıca sulanmadan yağmur suyuyla yetişen toprak ve ürünü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal tarımsal arazinin ve ürünün su edinme biçimini karşıt yönlerden sınıflandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Paylaşılan eksen ek sulamadır: bu dalda su verme vardır, komşuda ürün yalnızca doğal yağışla yetinir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal genel sulamayı ve özellikle sert toprağın sürme öncesinde sulanmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sürülmüş ürüne verilen ilk sulamayı özel bir aşama olarak anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: sürme öncesi sulama ve sürme sonrası ilk sulama
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal tarım sürecinde belirli bir aşamada toprağa veya ürüne su verilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda özel aşama sürmeden öncedir; komşuda ise sürme tamamlandıktan sonraki ilk sulamadır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen komşular genel sulama, sulamasız yetişme ve ilk sulama aşaması üzerinden en yararlı sınırları verir, kalanlar toprak hazırlama veya suyun sonucu alanındadır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه سقي الأرض الصلبة قبل حرثها، والسقية للزرع، ووصف الزرع بأنه ممكور أي مسقي.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الاحتيال والخداع ولا النبات المسمى المكر ولا خدالة الساق ولا المغرة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: المكر: سقي الأرض؛ امكروا الأرض فإنها صلبة ثم احرثوها؛ المكرة: السقية للزرع؛ زرع ممكور أي مسقي (tahdhib)

source_note.TA: Toprağı sulama, sert toprağı sürme öncesinde suyla hazırlama, ürüne verilen bir sulama ve sulanmış ürün durumu birlikte tanıklanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek ve açık biçimde bozulmuş yaş hurmayı adlandırır. Anlam genel olarak her bozuk meyveye, kuru hurmaya veya olgunlaşma sürecindeki sağlam hurmaya genişletilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yaş hurma türündeki meyvenin bozulmuş durumuyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca yalın biçimde tanıklanan bozulmuş yaş hurma anlamını verir ve başka meyve durumlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bozulmuş veya yenmeye elverişliliğini yitirmiş yaş hurmadır.

facets.statement: Yaş hurmanın bozulmuş ve yenmeye elverişsiz duruma gelmiş olanını adlandırmak.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu anlamın çoğul kaynaklar arasında paylaşılmış bir tanıklığı yoktur; dal tek kaynaktaki kısa ve bağımsız meyve durumu aktarımına dayanır.

source_details.summary: Bozulmuş yaş hurmayı adlandıran bağımsız bir söz varlığı anlamı olarak tanıklanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Meyvenin türünü ve bozulmuş durumunu eksiksiz veren kısa temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaş hurma kimliğini ve meyvenin bozulmuş olma durumunu birlikte korur.
Hurma meyvesi olma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Yaş hurma oluşunu ve bozulmuşluk durumunu siler.
error_profile.adds: Meyvenin kurutulmuş veya kuru evrede bulunması anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Bozulmuş yaş meyveyle kuru hurma evresini birbirine karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal özellikle bozulmuş yaş hurmayı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal küçük, içi boş veya çekirdeksiz bozuk hurma ve benzeri içsiz meyve örneklerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bozulmuş yaş hurma ve içi boş bozuk meyve
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal hurmanın bozulmuş veya kusurlu olup yenme değerini yitirdiği alanda yaklaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın sınırı yaş hurmanın bozulmasıdır; komşu dalda iç boşluğu, küçüklük ve başka meyve örnekleri de kurucudur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yaş hurmanın bozulmuş durumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hurmanın yalnızca bir yanında olgunlaşma ve yumuşama başlamasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bozulmuş yaş hurma ve kısmen olgunlaşan hurma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal hurmanın yaş ve olgunlaşan evrelerindeki durumlarını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bozulma bir kusur durumudur; bir yanda olgunlaşmanın başlaması ise olağan gelişim evresidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bozulmuş olmakla birlikte yaş durumdaki hurmaya özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kurumuş, buruşmuş veya içi geçmiş hurmayı ve kuru eti kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bozulmuş yaş hurma ve kuruyup buruşmuş hurma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal hurmanın yenme niteliğini düşüren olumsuz meyve durumlarını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda yaşlık korunurken bozulma vardır; komşuda ayırıcı durum kuruma ve buruşmadır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; seçilen üç komşu bozukluk, kısmi olgunlaşma ve kuruma ayrımlarını açıklar, kalanlar başka hurma veya meyve türlerini adlandırır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المكرة بمعنى الرطبة الفاسدة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الاحتيال والخداع ولا النبات والشجر ولا خدالة الساق ولا المغرة ولا سقي الأرض.
branches.source_phrase_ar: المكرة: الرطبة الفاسدة (tahdhib)

root_profile.summary: Kök, gizli hileyle amaç saptırma; dolgun ve biçimli baldır; belirli bir bitki veya ağaç; aşı boyası ve boyama; toprağı sulama; bozulmuş yaş hurma olmak üzere büyük ölçüde bağımsız altı anlam dalı taşır. Bazı dallarda dolgunluk veya suyla ilişki sezilse de kanıt, bunları tek bir tanım altında birleştirmeyi gerektirmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, iki şeyin birbirine dönük ve karşı karşıya bulunmasını temel alır; ön tarafın arka tarafın karşıtı oluşunu, yüz yüze görüşü ve karşıdan görülen yer yönünü de bu çekirdeğe bağlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal zamansal önceliği, hoşnutlukla benimsemeyi veya güvence üstlenmeyi değil, uzamsal ya da algısal karşı karşıyalığı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yön ve ön taraf anlamını korur; yüz yüze yapma, karşısında bulunma ve yönsüz kalma gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımları ayrı yüzeyler olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başka bir şeye dönük, onun karşısında ya da yüz yüze bulunması ve bu ilişki içinde belirlenen ön taraf veya yöndür. Karşıdan görülen yamaç ile doğrudan görerek yapma, bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: İki şey birbirine dönüktür ve karşı karşıya bulunur.
Bir şeyin ön tarafı, arka tarafının karşıtı olarak bu yön ilişkisiyle belirlenir.
Bir işi yüz yüze ve doğrudan görerek yapmak, karşı karşıyalığın eylem bağlamındaki kullanımıdır.
Dağın ya da arazinin bakana dönük yüzü, yön çekirdeğinin yer biçimlerine uygulanmasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşı karşıya bulunma, önün arkaya karşıt oluşu ve doğrudan görüş altında yapma anlamlarında birleşir; yer şeklinin bakana dönük yüzü de aynı yön düzenine bağlanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin sonrakine göre önce gelmesini ve henüz gelmemiş yıl ya da gecenin yaklaşmasını aynı öncelik düzeninde toplar. Gençliğin başlangıcı da bu düzenin yaşam evresine uygulanmasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yüz yüze karşılaşmayı değil; zaman, yer, sıra veya düzey bakımından önce oluşu ve yaklaşan dönemi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel önce ve sonra karşıtlığını korur; gelecek yıl, bundan sonrası ve gençliğin başlangıcı gibi biçime ya da kalıba bağlı kullanımları buna karıştırmadan belirtir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin zaman, yer, sıra veya düzey bakımından başka bir şeyden önce bulunmasıdır. Yaklaşan yıl ya da gece ile bir yaşam evresinin başlangıcı, bu öncelik çizgisinin ileriye dönük özel kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey, zaman, yer, sıra veya düzey bakımından sonrakinin önünde bulunur.
Henüz gelmemiş yıl veya gece, yaklaşan ve sırada olan dönem diye belirtilir.
Gençliğin ilk evresi, yaşlılık belirtisi henüz görünmeden önceki başlangıç dönemi olarak anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar önce ile sonra arasındaki karşıtlığı temel alır ve bu ilişkiyi yaklaşan dönemlere, gelecekteki zamana ve gençliğin ilk evresine uygular.

concept_gloss.applicability: Öncelik ile gelecek dönemin yaklaşmasını tek bir sıra ilişkisi içinde anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi, özrü veya dönüşü hoşnutlukla uygun bulup alma eylemini temel alır; bir kimsenin göze ya da gönle hoş gelmesi de bu olumlu karşılamanın görünüşe bağlı uzantısıdır.

concept_map.definition: Sunulan bir şeyi, sözü, özrü ya da dönüşü uygun bulup benimsemek ve geri çevirmemektir. Bir kişinin göze veya gönle hoş gelmesi, bu olumlu karşılamanın kişiye yönelmiş özel kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey uygun bulunur, benimsenir ve geri çevrilmez.
Özür, dönüş, armağan veya emek gibi sunulan şeyler olumlu karşılanabilir.
Bir kişinin görünüşü ya da hali göze ve gönle hoş gelebilir.
